user.title: Ecobee Utility Events
user.description:
Surfaces the utility time-of-use curtailment events (touPrecool / touSetback / demandResponse) that the core ecobee integration fetches and then discards.

No credentials are needed: this reads the ecobee integration's existing in-memory data and makes no additional calls to api.ecobee.com.

{status}

Select Submit to add it.
